questions.stem:
Combustion of 1 mole of benzene is expressed at
$\mathrm{C_6H_6(l) + \frac{15}{2}O_2(g) \rightarrow CO_2(g) + 3H_2O(l)}$.
The standard enthalpy of combustion of 2 mol of benzene is – 'x' kJ.
x = ______.
(1) standard Enthalpy of formation of 1 mol of $\mathrm{C_6H_6(l)}$, for the reaction
$\mathrm{6C(graphite) + 3H_2(g) \rightarrow C_6H_6(l)}$ is $48.5\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$.
(2) Standard Enthalpy of formation of 1 mol of $\mathrm{CO_2(g)}$, for the reaction
$\mathrm{C(graphite) + O_{2(g)} \rightarrow CO_2(g)}$ is $-393.5\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$.
(3) Standard and Enthalpy of formation of 1 mol of $\mathrm{H_2O(l)}$, for the reaction
$\mathrm{H_2(g) + \frac{1}{2}O_2(g) \rightarrow H_2O(l)}$ is $-286\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}$.
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{6C(graphite) + 3H_2(g) \rightarrow C_6H_6(\ell)}$; $\Delta H = 48.5$ kJ/mol
$\mathrm{C(graphite) + O_2(g) \rightarrow CO_2(g)}$; $\Delta H = -393.5$ kJ/mol
$\mathrm{H_2^{(g)}} + \frac{1}{2}\mathrm{(g)} \longrightarrow \mathrm{H_2O(\ell)}$ ; $\Delta H = -286$ kJ/mol
equation $-(1) \times 1 + (2) \times 6 + (3) \times 3$
$-48.5 - 6 \times 393.5 - 3 \times 286$
$= -3267.5$ kJ for 1 mol
$= -6535$ kJ for 2 mol
Ans. 6535 kJ

questions.stem:
Considering acetic acid dissociates in water, its dissociation constant is $6.25 \times 10^{-5}$. If 5 mL of acetic acid is dissolved in 1 litre water, the solution will freeze at $-x \times 10^{-2}\ ^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$, provided pure water freezes at $0\ ^{\circ}\mathrm{C}$.
$x$ = _________. (Nearest integer)
Given : $(K_f)_{\mathrm{water}} = 1.86\ \mathrm{K\,kg\,mol^{-1}}$.
density of acetic acid is $1.2\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$
molar mass of water $= 18\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$.
molar mass of acetic acid $= 60\ \mathrm{g\,mol^{-1}}$.
density of water $= 1\ \mathrm{g\,cm^{-3}}$
Acetic acid dissociates as
$\mathrm{CH_3COOH \rightleftharpoons CH_3COO^{\ominus} + H^{\oplus}}$
questions.solution:
Mass of $\mathrm{CH_3COOH} = V \times d$
$= 5\ \mathrm{ml} \times 1.2\ \mathrm{g/ml}$
$= 6$ gm
$n_{\mathrm{CH_3COOH}} = \frac{6}{60} = 0.1\,\mathrm{mol}$
$m_{\mathrm{CH_3COOH}} \approx M_{\mathrm{CH_3COOH}} = \frac{0.1}{1} = 0.1\mathrm{M}$
$\mathrm{CH_3COOH \rightleftharpoons CH_3COO^{-} + H^{+}}$
$C$ | 0 | 0
$C - C\alpha$ | $C\alpha$ | $C\alpha$
$K_a = \frac{C\alpha^{2}}{1-\alpha}$
$1 - \alpha \approx 1 \Rightarrow K_a = C\alpha^{2}$
$\alpha = \sqrt{\frac{K_a}{C}} = \sqrt{\frac{6.25 \times 10^{-5}}{0.1}} = 25 \times 10^{-3}$
V.f. (i) $= 1 + \alpha(n-1) = 1 + \alpha(2-1) = 1 + \alpha$
$= 1 + 25 \times 10^{-3} = 1.025$
$\Delta T_f = iK_f m$
$= (1.025)(1.86)(0.1)$
$= 0.19$
$= 19 \times 10^{-2}$
